title: 'भिखारी' कवितामा मानवतावाद{ Humanism in 'The Beggar' Poem}
nepali: प्रस्तुत लेखमा लक्ष्मीप्रसाद देवकोटाद्वारा लिखित भिखारी कविताभित्र प्रयुक्त मानवतावादी दृष्टिको स्थितिपहिचान र खोजअन्वेषण गरिएको छ । कविद्वारा अभिव्यक्त मानवीय संवेदनाहरूलाई नौ श्लोकमा संरचितभिखारी कविताका पृष्ठभूमिमा केन्द्रित रही मानवतावादी सिद्घान्तका आधारमा केलाउनु नै यस अध्ययनकोमूल उद्देश्य रहेको छ । कविताको अर्थापनका लागि पूर्वीय र पाश्चात्य साहित्य सिद्घान्तका सन्दर्भहरूमाआधारित भएर पाठ विश्लेषण विधिका जगमा सूक्ष्म पठन गरी गुणात्मक प्रकृतिको अध्ययन गरिएको छ ।कवितामा प्रस्तुत मानवतावादी चिन्तनसम्बन्धी समस्यालाई मूल प्राज्ञिक समस्या बनाएर त्यसको समाधानखोज्न कवितामा प्रयुक्त भनाइको गाम्भीर्यता र मानव मनको संवेदनालाई मानवतावादी काव्य सौन्दर्यका आधारमा विश्लेषण गर्नु नै अध्ययनको केन्द्रबिन्दु हो । आजको युगमा मानव जातिमा बढ्दै गएको स्वार्थ र लोभानिपापानिबाट मुक्त हुन नसकेको यथार्थता, समाजमा मानवभित्रको दानवीय प्रवृत्ति र गर्विलो स्वाभिमानबाट स्खलित हुँदै घृणित बन्नुपरेको अवस्थालाई मानवतावादी दृष्टिकोणका आधारमा केलाइएको छ । यसमा मानव–मानव बिचमा हुनुपर्ने समानता र मानवतावादी दृष्टिकोणलाई मानवजीवन, दर्शन र सभ्य समाज निर्माणमा मानवको भूमिका के कस्तो रेहेको छ भन्ने कुरालाई विश्लेषण गरिएको छ । पुस्तकालयीय सन्दर्भ सामग्रीको उपयोग गरिएको यस लेखमा विशेष गरेर मानवतावादी काव्य सौन्दर्य पहिचान गर्नुलाई मुल उद्देश्य बनाइएको छ । समसामयिक मानवीय जीवनका जटिलताहरूले मानवमनमा पार्ने आघातबाट उत्पन्न संवेदनागत विषयवस्तुलाई प्रतीकात्मक अभिव्यक्ति दिँदै ‘भिखारी’ कवितामा व्यञ्जित बिम्बात्मक भावका आधारमा मानवतावादी काव्य सौन्दर्यचेत मुखरित भएको निष्कर्ष निकालिएको छ । {In the presented article, the position of the humanist vision used in the beggar poem written by Lakshmi Prasad Devkota has been identified and researched. The main purpose of this study is to analyze the human feelings expressed by the poet on the basis of humanistic principles while focusing on the background of the beggar poem structured in nine stanzas. Based on the references of Eastern and Western literary theory for the meaning of the poem, qualitative nature has been studied by careful reading on the basis of text analysis method. The focus of the study is to analyze the seriousness of the words used in the poem and the sentiments of the human mind on the basis of the humanist poetic beauty by making the problem related to humanist thinking presented in the poem an original academic problem. In today's age, the reality that human beings cannot be freed from selfishness and greed, the demonic tendencies in the society and the situation where they have to become hateful from proud self-respect, has been explained on the basis of humanistic point of view. It has analyzed the equality between humans and the humanistic approach to human life, philosophy and the role of humans in building a civilized society. In this article, which uses library reference material, the main objective is to identify the humanistic poetic beauty. By giving a symbolic expression to the emotional content arising from the trauma of the contemporary human life, it is concluded that the humanist poetic aesthetic is expressed based on the figurative expression expressed in the poem 'Bhikhari'.}
american_english: In this article, the position of the humanist vision used within the poem 'Bhikhari' written by Lakshmi Prasad Devkota has been identified and explored. Centering on the background of the poem 'Bhikhari', structured in nine stanzas and expressing the human sentiments articulated by the poet, to analyze them on the basis of humanist principles is the main objective of this study. For the interpretation of the poem, on the basis of the references of Eastern and Western literary theory, a qualitative study has been carried out through close reading on the foundation of the text analysis method. Making the problem related to humanist thought presented in the poem the main academic problem, to find its solution, analyzing the gravity of the words used in the poem and the sentiments of the human mind on the basis of humanist poetic beauty is the focal point of the study. In today's age, the reality that humanity cannot free itself from growing selfishness and greed, the demonic tendency within humans in society, and the situation of having to become contemptible by slipping from proud self-respect have been examined on the basis of the humanist viewpoint. In this, the equality that should exist between human and human, and the humanist viewpoint, have been analyzed in terms of what kind of role humans have in human life, philosophy, and the construction of a civilized society. In this article, which uses library reference material, the main objective has in particular been made to identify humanist poetic beauty. Giving symbolic expression to the emotional content arising from the trauma that the complexities of contemporary human life inflict on the human mind, it is concluded that the humanist poetic aesthetic consciousness has been articulated on the basis of the figurative imagery expressed in the poem 'Bhikhari'.

informal_english: This article looks at the humanist vision in Lakshmi Prasad Devkota's poem 'Bhikhari' and tracks down where it sits. The main aim was to centre on the poem's background — it's built in nine stanzas and full of human feeling from the poet — and to pull it apart using humanist principles. For making sense of the poem, we leaned on Eastern and Western literary theory and did a close, qualitative read using text analysis. The heart of it was treating the humanist problem raised in the poem as the main academic question, finding a way through it, and weighing up the gravity of the poem's words and the feelings of the human mind against humanist poetic beauty. These days people can't shake off growing selfishness and greed, there's a demonic streak in society, and proud self-respect slips into something contemptible — all of that gets examined through a humanist lens. It also looks at the equality that should exist between people, and at what role humans actually play in human life, philosophy, and building a civilised society. This one draws on library references, and the main goal was to pin down the humanist poetic beauty in particular. By giving symbolic expression to the emotional fallout from the trauma of modern life, the conclusion is that the humanist poetic aesthetic consciousness comes through in the figurative imagery of 'Bhikhari'.
